findings.description: The plan conflicts on the source of truth for configured status: F002 says downstream consumers read only append-only evidence files, while the F004 matrix derives some configured states from env-var name presence. That can clear or advance integration status without captured evidence.
findings.recommendation: Pin env-var presence as display-only readiness context, or define an evidence-writing credential probe/attestation record as the only status-clearing input.

findings.description: The trigger condition for Firebase deploy/realtime work is met only by operator-attested evidence, but the attest command is specified only as integration/outcome/note and does not pin an action identifier or trigger-record type.
findings.recommendation: Add a deterministic attestation grammar for action_id and trigger records, then bind gated ActionItems to those exact records in clears_when/status derivation.

findings.description: Post-clear visibility is not mechanically pinned against the shipped clears_when suppression model. A pending item that clears via clears_when will be suppressed unless the plan defines a separate quiet status item or a band-transform path.
findings.recommendation: Specify whether cleared integrations re-emit as quiet status ActionItems, or whether integration clears_when changes band instead of suppressing the item.

findings.description: The static-dashboard smoke acceptance says rendered artifacts must exist, but artifact existence alone is weaker than render-proof and may not fail parseable-but-unrenderable dashboard state.
findings.recommendation: Require the smoke to invoke the real dashboard renderer or browser/DOM path and assert non-empty rendered surfaces from the exported state.

findings.description: The proposed source/provider wiring pins the main build path, but the standard dashboard can also flow through fleet/project projection rehydration, where unknown sources and new display fields can be filtered or dropped.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit fleet/selected-dashboard projection coverage for SOURCE_INTEGRATION and all new display fields through fleet-what-now and operator-triage rendering.
